verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê ’el- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl šim·‘ū də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you son of man prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say O mountains of Israel hear the word of the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֣עַן הָאוֹיֵ֛ב אָמַ֧ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח עוֹלָ֔ם וּבָמ֣וֹת הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an hā·’ō·w·yêḇ ’ā·mar ‘ă·lê·ḵem he·’āḥ ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḇā·mō·wṯ hā·yə·ṯāh lā·nū lə·mō·w·rā·šāh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because the enemy has said of you Aha The ancient heights have become our possession

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אָמַ֖ר יַ֣עַן בְּיַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְשָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִסָּבִ֗יב לִֽהְיוֹתְכֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַתֵּֽעֲל֛וּ וְדִבַּת־ עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nā·ḇê wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an bə·ya·‘an šam·mō·wṯ wə·šā·’ōp̄ ’eṯ·ḵem mis·sā·ḇîḇ lih·yō·wṯ·ḵem mō·w·rā·šāh liš·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim wat·tê·‘ă·lū wə·ḏib·baṯ- ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ lā·šō·wn ‘ām
verses.literal: therefore prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Because . . . they have made you desolate and have trampled you on every side so that you became a possession of the rest of the nations and were taken up in slander by the lips of [their] talkers . . .

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְ֠הוִה אָמַ֣ר לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָי֗וֹת הַשֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְלֶחֳרָב֤וֹת הַנֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת וְלֶעָרִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְבַז֙ וּלְלַ֔עַג לִשְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִסָּבִֽיב׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl šim·‘ū də·ḇar- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar le·hā·rîm wə·lag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ lā·’ă·p̄î·qîm wə·lag·gê·’ā·yō·wṯ haš·šō·mə·mō·wṯ wə·le·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ han·ne·‘ĕ·zā·ḇō·wṯ wə·le·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer hā·yū lə·ḇaz ū·lə·la·‘aḡ liš·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: therefore O mountains of Israel hear the word of the Lord GOD This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills to the ravines and valleys to the desolate ruins and abandoned cities which have become a spoil and a mockery to the rest of the nations - around you

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אָמַר֮ אִם־ לֹ֠א בְּאֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְעַל־ כֻּלָּ֑א אֱד֣וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ־ אֶת־ אַרְצִ֣י׀ לָ֠הֶם לְמ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה כָּל־ לֵבָב֙ בְּשִׂמְחַ֤ת בִּשְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖הּ לָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’im- lō bə·’êš qin·’ā·ṯî ḏib·bar·tî ‘al- šə·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim wə·‘al- kul·lā ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū- ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî lā·hem lə·mō·w·rā·šāh kāl- lê·ḇāḇ bə·śim·ḥaṯ biš·’āṭ ne·p̄eš lə·ma·‘an miḡ·rā·šāh lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Surely . . . in My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Edom who took - My land . . . as their own possession with wholehearted . . . joy and utter contempt . . . so that its pastureland became plunder

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים וְ֠לַגְּבָעוֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֨ים וְלַגֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אָמַ֣ר׀ הִנְנִ֨י דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי וּבַחֲמָתִי֙ בְקִנְאָתִ֤י יַ֛עַן נְשָׂאתֶֽם׃ כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nā·ḇê ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā le·hā·rîm wə·lag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ lā·’ă·p̄î·qîm wə·lag·gê·’ā·yō·wṯ kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî dib·bar·tî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî ḇə·qin·’ā·ṯî ya·‘an nə·śā·ṯem kə·lim·maṯ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and tell the mountains and hills the ravines and valleys that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I have spoken in My burning zeal because you have endured the reproach of the nations

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֑י אִם־ לֹ֤א הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִסָּבִ֔יב לָכֶ֣ם הֵ֖מָּה יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃ כְּלִמָּתָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’ă·nî nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ’im- lō hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer mis·sā·ḇîḇ lā·ḵem hêm·māh yiś·śā·’ū kə·lim·mā·ṯām
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says I have sworn - with an uplifted hand that surely . . . the nations - around you . . . will endure reproach of their own

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ תִּתֵּ֔נוּ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl tit·tê·nū ‘an·pə·ḵem tiś·’ū ū·p̄er·yə·ḵem lə·‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl kî qê·rə·ḇū lā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: But you O mountains of Israel will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel for they will soon come home

verses.original: כִּ֖י הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯî ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·ne·‘ĕ·ḇaḏ·tem wə·niz·ra‘·tem
verses.literal: For behold I am on your side I will turn toward you and you will be tilled and sown

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י אָדָ֔ם עֲלֵיכֶם֙ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה הֶֽעָרִ֔ים וְנֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ וְהֶחֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’ā·ḏām ‘ă·lê·ḵem kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kul·lōh he·‘ā·rîm wə·nō·šə·ḇū wə·he·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ tib·bā·ne·nāh
verses.literal: I will multiply the people upon you - the house of Israel in its entirety The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה וְרָב֣וּ וּפָר֑וּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh wə·rā·ḇū ū·p̄ā·rū wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem kə·qaḏ·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·hê·ṭi·ḇō·ṯî mê·ri·šō·ṯê·ḵem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will fill . . . you with people and animals and they will multiply and be fruitful I will make you as inhabited - as you once were and I will make you prosper more than before Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: אָדָ֜ם אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם וִֽירֵשׁ֔וּךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה וְלֹא־ תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְשַׁכְּלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ’eṯ- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·hō·w·laḵ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem wî·rê·šū·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā lā·hem lə·na·ḥă·lāh wə·lō- ṯō·w·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·šak·kə·lām
verses.literal: Yes, {I will cause} My people Israel to walk upon you they will possess you and you will be their inheritance and you will no longer . . . deprive them [of their children]

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אָתִּי אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם גּוֹיֵךְ הָיִֽית׃ וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an ’ō·mə·rîm lā·ḵem ʾå̄t·tī ’ō·ḵe·leṯ ’ā·ḏām gō·yēḵ hā·yîṯ ū·mə·šak·ke·leṯ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Because people say to you You devour men and deprive your nation . . . of its children

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן לֹא־ ע֔וֹד תֹ֣אכְלִי אָדָם֙ תְכַשְּׁלִי ע֑וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ לֹ֣א נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên lō- ‘ō·wḏ ṯō·ḵə·lî ’ā·ḏām ṯə·ḵaš·šə·lī ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡō·yēḵ lō nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive . . . your nation {of its children} . . . declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְלֹא־ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ לֹ֣א ע֑וֹד תִשְׂאִי־ וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹא־ ע֔וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ תַכְשִׁ֣לִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ kə·lim·maṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’aš·mî·a‘ ’ê·la·yiḵ lō ‘ō·wḏ ṯiś·’î- wə·ḥer·paṯ ‘am·mîm lō- ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡō·yēḵ ṯaḵ·ši·lî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples [or] . . . cause your nation to stumble declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם וַיְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּדַרְכָּ֖ם וּבַעֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם דַרְכָּ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃ הָיְתָ֥ה כְּטֻמְאַת֙ הַנִּדָּ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl yō·šə·ḇîm ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām way·ṭam·mə·’ū ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·ḏar·kām ū·ḇa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām ḏar·kām lə·p̄ā·nāy hā·yə·ṯāh kə·ṭum·’aṯ han·nid·dāh
verses.literal: Son of man when the people of Israel lived in their land they defiled it by their own ways and deeds Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a [woman’s] impurity

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·pōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem ‘al- had·dām ’ă·šer- šā·p̄ə·ḵū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ṭim·mə·’ū·hā ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem
verses.literal: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood - they had shed on the land and because they had defiled it with their idols

verses.original: וָאָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּזָּר֖וּ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃ כְּדַרְכָּ֥ם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·p̄îṣ ’ō·ṯām bag·gō·w·yim way·yiz·zā·rū bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ šə·p̄aṭ·tîm kə·ḏar·kām wə·ḵa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I dispersed them among the nations and they were scattered throughout the lands I judged them according to their ways and deeds

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ הַגּוֹיִם֙ שָׁ֔ם וַֽיְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ קָדְשִׁ֑י שֵׁ֣ם בֶּאֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה עַם־ יְהוָ֣ה יָצָֽאוּ׃ וּמֵאַרְצ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- ’ă·šer- bā·’ū hag·gō·w·yim šām way·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm be·’ĕ·mōr lā·hem ’êl·leh ‘am- Yah·weh yā·ṣā·’ū ū·mê·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: - - And wherever they went among the nations . . . they profaned - My holy name because it was said of them These are the people of the LORD yet they had to leave His land

verses.original: וָאֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל־ קָדְשִׁ֑י שֵׁ֣ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חִלְּל֙וּהוּ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḥ·mōl ‘al- qāḏ·šî šêm ’ă·šer bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ḥil·lə·lū·hū bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·’ū šām·māh
verses.literal: But I had concern for My holy name which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone . . .

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם־ קָדְשִׁי֙ לְשֵׁם־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar lō lə·ma·‘an·ḵem ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî ’im- qāḏ·šî lə·šêm- ’ă·šer ḥil·lal·tem bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·ṯem šām
verses.literal: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says It is not for your sake that I will act O house of Israel but . . . for My holy name which you profaned among the nations to which you went . . .

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת־ הַגָּד֗וֹל שְׁמִ֣י הַֽמְחֻלָּל֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָ֑ם הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְיָדְע֨וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·daš·tî ’eṯ- hag·gā·ḏō·wl šə·mî ham·ḥul·lāl bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ḥil·lal·tem bə·ṯō·w·ḵām hag·gō·w·yim wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·hiq·qā·ḏə·šî ḇā·ḵem lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: I will show the holiness - of My great name which has been profaned among the nations the name you have profaned among them Then the nations will know that I am the LORD declares the Lord GOD when I show My holiness in you before their eyes

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hag·gō·w·yim wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries and I will bring you back into your own land

verses.original: וְזָרַקְתִּ֧י טְהוֹרִ֖ים מַ֥יִם עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם׃ מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכָּל־ גִּלּ֥וּלֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·raq·tî ṭə·hō·w·rîm ma·yim ‘ă·lê·ḵem ū·ṭə·har·tem ’ă·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ṭum·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·mik·kāl- gil·lū·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: I will also sprinkle clean water on you and you will be clean I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ חָדָ֔שׁ לֵ֣ב אֶתֵּ֣ן חֲדָשָׁ֖ה וְר֥וּחַ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־ לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem ḥā·ḏāš lêḇ ’et·tên ḥă·ḏā·šāh wə·rū·aḥ bə·qir·bə·ḵem wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- lêḇ hā·’e·ḇen wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem lêḇ bā·śār mib·bə·śar·ḵem
verses.literal: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you I will remove - your heart of stone and give you a heart . . . of flesh

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֶתֵּ֣ן רוּחִ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ בְּחֻקַּי֙ תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’et·tên rū·ḥî bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tê·lê·ḵū bə·ḥuq·qay tiš·mə·rū wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ū·miš·pā·ṭay
verses.literal: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause - - you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances

verses.original: וִישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·šaḇ·tem bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem lî lə·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers you will be My people and I will be your God

verses.original: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֤אתִי אֶל־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן רָעָֽב׃ עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ṭum·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·qā·rā·ṯî ’el- had·dā·ḡān wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’ō·ṯōw wə·lō- ’et·tên rā·‘āḇ ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: I will save you from all your uncleanness I will summon . . . the grain and make it plentiful - and I will not bring famine upon you

verses.original: פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ וּתְנוּבַ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְהִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת־ לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א ע֛וֹד תִקְח֥וּ חֶרְפַּ֥ת בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃ רָעָ֖ב
verses.transliteration: pə·rî hā·‘êṣ ū·ṯə·nū·ḇaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer lō ‘ō·wḏ ṯiq·ḥū ḥer·paṯ bag·gō·w·yim rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: I will also make the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field plentiful - so that - you will no longer bear reproach among the nations on account of famine

verses.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ הָרָעִ֔ים דַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ טוֹבִ֑ים וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·ḵar·tem ’eṯ- hā·rā·‘îm dar·ḵê·ḵem ū·ma·‘al·lê·ḵem ’ă·šer lō- ṭō·w·ḇîm ū·nə·qō·ṭō·ṯem bip̄·nê·ḵem ‘al ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem wə·‘al tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will remember - your evil ways and wicked deeds - - . . . and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and abominations

verses.original: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי־ עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָכֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְהִכָּלְמ֛וּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō lə·ma·‘an·ḵem ’ă·nî- ‘ō·śeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh yiw·wā·ḏa‘ lā·ḵem bō·wō·šū wə·hik·kā·lə·mū mid·dar·ḵê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: It is not for your sake that I will act declares the Lord GOD let it be known to you Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways O house of Israel

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃ וְנִבְנ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar bə·yō·wm ṭa·hă·rî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem he·‘ā·rîm wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- he·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ wə·niḇ·nū
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says On the day I cleanse you from all your iniquities I will cause the cities to be resettled - and the ruins to be rebuilt

verses.original: הַנְּשַׁמָּ֖ה וְהָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּֽעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·šam·māh wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tê·‘ā·ḇêḏ ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh šə·mā·māh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ō·w·ḇêr
verses.literal: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of - lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ הַלֵּ֙זוּ֙ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּגַן־ עֵ֑דֶן וְהֶעָרִ֧ים הֶחֳרֵב֛וֹת וְהַֽנְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְהַנֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū hal·lê·zū hā·’ā·reṣ han·nə·šam·māh hā·yə·ṯāh kə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen wə·he·‘ā·rîm he·ḥo·rê·ḇō·wṯ wə·han·šam·mō·wṯ wə·han·ne·hĕ·rā·sō·wṯ bə·ṣū·rō·wṯ yā·šā·ḇū
verses.literal: Then they will say This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden The cities that were once ruined desolate and destroyed are now fortified and inhabited

verses.original: הַגּוֹיִ֗ם סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ וְיָדְע֣וּ כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ הַנֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַנְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·yim sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer yiš·šā·’ă·rū wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh bā·nî·ṯî han·ne·hĕ·rā·sō·wṯ nā·ṭa‘·tî han·nə·šam·māh ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and I have replanted what was desolate I the LORD have spoken and I will do it

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ ע֗וֹד אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם זֹ֛את אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם אָדָֽם׃ כַּצֹּ֖אן
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘ō·wḏ ’id·dā·rêš lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·hem zōṯ ’ar·beh ’ō·ṯām ’ā·ḏām kaṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Once again I will hear the plea of the house of Israel and do for them this I will multiply - their people like a flock

verses.original: כְּצֹ֣אן קָֽדָשִׁ֗ים כְּצֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּמ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֤ן הֶחֳרֵב֔וֹת הֶעָרִ֣ים תִּהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣōn qā·ḏā·šîm kə·ṣōn yə·rū·šā·lim bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏe·hā kên he·ḥo·rê·ḇō·wṯ he·‘ā·rîm tih·ye·nāh mə·lê·’ō·wṯ ṣōn ’ā·ḏām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Like the numerous flocks for sacrifices . . . at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people Then they will know that I am the LORD
